verdict.rationale: Shell integration is a fair question for a terminal emulator, but the evidence pack never documents command-aware features such as exit status, command duration, or notifications when long commands finish. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: letting applications change the window title, and setting environment variables for the shell. One user even complains that Alacritty lacks activity/silence monitoring.

support.subject: As a developer, I get command-aware features from shell integration, like exit status, duration, and notifications when long commands finish
